_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No volume, funding, fear, or calendar impulse is present to exit the Denial coil; statistically honest default is HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Denial and non-directional stance; narrative offers no competing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds ~1.5% range with fear_greed 25-40 and funding near flat through the weekend
next_move.invalidated_if: Volume impulse: fear_greed under 20 with negative funding (down to Panic) or spot CVD/ETF surge lifting fear_greed through 40 (up to Anxiety)
